pages.title: Easel AI Artist Assistant Page
pages.description: A two-ink risograph page for an AI studio assistant for artists: four pink ink drums roll down the hero and print a panel as you scroll, blue and pink plates slide into register, every illustration is greyscale SVG turned duotone by a blend, and a live plan ticket prices as you pick
